AddrRef.description: "any", "@group-name", a network in CIDR form, or a single address

DhcpPool.description: An IPv4 address pool handed out on one interface.

dns.description:
The DNS servers clients are told to use. Defaults to the box itself
when its resolver serves this interface's zone.

lease.description: How long a client keeps its address, such as `12h`. Defaults to 12h.

static.description: Devices that always get the same address.

Dns.description:
A DNS resolver for the box's networks. It forwards to `upstream` and
answers for the local names in `hosts` and for DHCP clients.

dnssec.description: Validate answers with DNSSEC. On by default.

domain.description:
The domain for local names, such as `home.arpa`. A host called `nas`
is then also `nas.home.arpa`.

upstream.description: The resolvers to forward to, such as `1.1.1.1`.

zones.description: The zones whose clients may use the resolver.

Forward.description:
A port forward. It only rewrites the destination. The packet still has to
pass the filter rule named in `rule`, so there is no hidden pass rule.

address.description:
The address the packet is sent to, before translation. Leave it out
to forward packets sent to any address the box itself has, which is
what to do when the provider assigns the box's address.

from.description: The zone the packet arrives from.

rule.description: ID of the accept rule that lets the translated packet through.

service.description: A TCP or UDP port or port range.

to.description: The internal host that receives the packet.

to_port.description: The port on the internal host. Defaults to the original port.

IfaceAddr.description: An interface address with its prefix length, such as 10.20.0.1/16

addresses.description:
Addresses of the box on this interface, each with its prefix length,
such as `10.20.0.1/16`.

default_route.description: True when the default route leaves by this interface.

dhcp_client.description:
Ask the network on this interface for the box's IPv4 address and
router (DHCP), as an internet provider's modem expects. Only on an
interface with `default_route` and no fixed IPv4 address.

gateway.description:
The routers the default route goes through, at most one for IPv4
and one for IPv6, such as `["203.0.113.1"]`. Only on an interface
with `default_route`. Leave it out when the address comes from the
network, which then names the router itself.

Lease.description: A lease time such as 30m, 12h or 7d

Mac.description: A hardware address such as aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff

forward.description: Port forwards: destination NAT to an internal host.

outbound.description: Source NAT for traffic leaving by a zone.

Net.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 network in CIDR form, or a single address

Policy.description: The rules for traffic from one zone to another.

log_default.description: Log packets that match no rule and are dropped. On by default.

to.description: A zone name, or `self` for traffic addressed to the box.

enabled.description: A disabled rule stays in the config and is left out of the ruleset.

id.description: Stable ID, unique in the config. It appears in logs and in `ox explain`.

reason.description: Why the rule exists, such as a change ticket.

ServiceRef.description: "any", a name from the services table, or a port such as "tcp/443"

name.description: The device's name. It becomes a local DNS name.

description: The whole config for one box.

addresses.description: Named address groups, used in rules as `@name`.

dhcp.description: IPv4 address pools, by interface name.

dns.description: A DNS resolver for the box's networks.

interfaces.description: Interfaces by kernel name, such as `lan0.20`.

ipv6_autoconfig.description:
Interfaces where the box announces its IPv6 network, so devices there
give themselves an address and learn the box as their router.

policy.description: One entry per zone pair. Rules in a pair are tried in order.

schema.description: Schema version of this document. Must be 1.

services.description: Named services, used in rules by name.

zones.description: Zones group interfaces. Rules are written between zones.

title: Config
